# [Your project name]

> [One line: what it does, and who it is for.]

## Agent Entry Points (All Models)

- `AGENTS.md` — Project guardrails and model-agnostic rules.
- `HANDOFF.md` — Active state, verification command, and next step.
- `mistakes.md` — Permanent "Never Repeat" guardrail log.
- `docs/START_HERE.md` — The one-page spec.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — Update briefing. Read before updating.
- `skills/agent-etiquette/SKILL.md` — Shared behaviour rules for AI agents.

## Key Paths

- `src/` — Project code (create it when the project needs it).
- `docs/START_HERE.md` — Spec template.
- `examples/example.md` — One tiny working example.
- `tests/smoke.test.mjs` — The one smoke test.

## Verification Command

`node tests/smoke.test.mjs`
